description: The Board window: no folder access of its own (each scan root the user picks, here or in Settings, is granted at runtime by src-tauri/src/settings.rs, for reading and watching only), watching its Projects' .scratch/ folders for changes, loading the Settings, picking and saving a scan root for the empty state's Add Folder (only a folder picked in the dialog is granted or saved), the two read-only gh commands the GitHub port runs (Homebrew's gh, or /usr/local/bin/gh as a fallback), and opening a Ticket through a vscode://file/ URL or its GitHub issue URL. Nothing here allows writing: no fs write permission is granted anywhere, as the runtime-granted scan roots apply to every fs command.
